content_blocks.text: The old oak tree stood tall, its branches whispering secrets to the wind. Sarah leaned against its trunk, feeling the rough bark under her fingers. She had come here every night since she was a child, seeking solace from the world’s noise. Tonight, however, there was something different about the air around her. A faint scent of jasmine lingered in the cool evening breeze, and as she closed her eyes, she heard a soft voice calling her name.
